All contributions of any kind are welcome: feature proposals, bug reports, direct code contributions, and design discussions.

Contribute through issues on GitLab, I monitor them: <https://gitlab.com/konradodwrot/che/homebrew-tap/-/issues>

## Generated Documentation

`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` are generated. Never edit them in this repository: the edit is overwritten on the next render.

Edit the prose parts in [centralized/assets/prose/human](https://gitlab.com/konradodwrot/centralized/assets/prose/human), then re-render:

```sh
$ make generic-files-tracked-generate
```
